Name: MajiTen: Maji de Tenshi o Tsukutte Mita
Overview: Create your own angel from five archetypes and spend your days as you like with them. Brought to you by the creative force behind the Ore no Yome series, Majiten is bringing the romance back. Earn money and go on dates. Your every decision affects the angels, design their wardrobe and direct your relationship. The game comes with an easy mode, so you can choose scenarios. For example, if you want things to stay light and fluffy, you can just choose the simple mode to get rid of the heavy scenes. And when your Love Points with your angel reaches a certain level, you'll be in for some special service scenarios.
